review.reason: The course layout is generally faithful and the illustration matches the reference style, but the putting greens have conspicuous dark surrounding collars that make them read as nested surfaces rather than single continuous greens.

issues.detail: Reduce the broad, dark ring around G1 so it reads as one continuous natural putting surface with only a subtle fringe.
Soften the dark perimeter collar around G2; keep the green as one continuous surface.
Soften the dark ring immediately around the island green at G3, while retaining the distinct water-to-island shoreline.
